app_info.subtitle: Manage your business website
app_info.description: Manage your KrabiClaw business website from ChatGPT. Choose a site and location, edit products and experiences, publish announcements and blog articles, update page content and translations, and upload or assign media. Review customer inquiries and experience bookings from your connected workspace. Publishing and content changes can appear on your public website. Some imports and document analysis use AI credits. A KrabiClaw account with access to the selected business is required. Site and location setup and deletion are managed in the KrabiClaw CMS.

test_cases.description: Add a menu item at the explicitly selected demo location.
test_cases.user_prompt: Use Ember & Slice, West Village. In Submission Drinks, add Submission Iced Coffee at 90 THB per item, tax-inclusive, with description “Coffee served over ice.” If that exact item already exists, show it and ask before creating a duplicate.
test_cases.expected_output: Creates one item only in the selected category and location with amount_minor 9000, currency THB, unit item, tax_behavior inclusive, and the supplied description.

test_cases.description: Update an existing menu item without changing other items.
test_cases.user_prompt: At Ember & Slice, West Village, update Espresso in Submission Drinks to 85 THB per item, tax-inclusive, and description “Freshly brewed espresso.” Keep its name and availability unchanged.
test_cases.expected_output: Updates the explicitly identified Espresso to amount_minor 8500 and the supplied description; other fields and products remain unchanged.

test_cases.description: Mark a menu item unavailable without deleting it.
test_cases.user_prompt: At Ember & Slice, West Village, mark Tea in Submission Drinks unavailable because it is sold out. Keep the item, price, and description so I can make it available again later.
test_cases.expected_output: Sets available to false on the explicitly identified Tea product. The product remains stored with its price and description unchanged; no product is deleted.

test_cases.user_prompt: At Ember & Slice, West Village, update Submission cooking class with tagline “Cook, taste, and learn together” and description “A hands-on cooking class with guided preparation and a shared meal.” Keep its price and duration unchanged.
test_cases.expected_output: Updates only the selected experience tagline and description, preserving price, duration, and scheduling.

test_cases.user_prompt: At Ember & Slice, West Village, change Submission cooking class to 90 minutes and 1,200 THB per person excluding tax. Keep its description and booking schedule unchanged.
test_cases.expected_output: Updates the selected experience to duration_minutes 90 and price amount_minor 120000, currency THB, unit person, tax_behavior exclusive; preserves content and booking schedule.
